title: A note's front matter
description: The YAML front matter of a note of the owner's notes home (brain notes): what brain notes check validates and brain notes find indexes. The folder gives the class; class only raises it. Unknown keys are kept and noted (an editor's own keys).

id.description: Stable, never reused: n-YYYYMMDD-HHMM (or a ULID after the prefix); the file name may change. brain notes check refuses a duplicate.

type.description: What the note is; its template and its folder (brain.notes.TYPES).

scope.description: Ids of the scope tree (an id, a path such as pro/acme, or global).

tags.description: Free tags; brain notes check says when two differ only by case.

status.description: Its maturity; archived is a status, never a folder.

links.description: The Brain ids it cites (items, ADRs, specs); the body's wikilinks are enough. brain notes check flags one the graph does not hold.

share.description: Where it may be exported (opt-in): notion; empty by default. Never for a confidential or sealed note.

summary.description: One or two sentences, by the owner or a local model.

aliases.description: Holds the id, so that an editor resolves [[id]].

class.description: Only to raise the folder's class, never to lower it.

kind.description: A source's kind: paper, book, web page, live document, slides, dataset...

access.description: A source's access: open, subscription, private...

file.description: A source's file by its hash (sha256:...), in attachments/.

zotero.description: The Zotero item key, when the source is in Zotero.
